title: The Events hub's plain header sits on the page background instead of a black box with unreadable dark type

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 (/events screenshot): bro wut? The Events header is a black box with dark text.

detail: SCAN-878 removed the photo element and gave .ev-hero.is-plain dark kit type, but the base .ev-hero rule still paints background:var(--fq-ink) for the photo band, so the header shipped as dark text on a black box. The plain variant now drops the background (and the band's isolation), so the title, search and buttons sit on the page like the other member hubs.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-events.css','utf8');if(!s.includes('.ev-hero.is-plain{background:none')){console.error('SCAN-902: the Events plain header still paints the dark photo base');process.exit(1)}"
